items.headline: Vikings LG Jackson likely out for season, LT Darrisaw has concussion
items.description: Vikings left guard Donovan Jackson is headed for what is likely season-ending surgery to repair a meniscus tear, and left tackle Christian Darrisaw is in the concussion protocol.

items.headline: NFL suspends officials Jeff Seeman, Adrian Hill for conduct toward players
items.description: The NFL has suspended line judge Jeff Seeman for two games for appearing to swear at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride. Referee Adrian Hill has been suspended one game for a separate incident in the Vikings' win over the Dolphins.

items.headline: How active NFL players continue to redefine all-time sack list
items.description: Myles Garrett's torrid pace up the all-time sack list paces active players making their moves among the greats.

items.headline: Vikings make history at 4-0 -- without a scoring offense
items.description: Minnesota sits atop the NFC North despite its special teams outscoring its offense the past three weeks.
